name: comp-105
title: Copy To Clipboard Button
blurb: Copy icon that scales into a green checkmark when clicked, then reverts.
description: A stateful button that toggles from copy icon to checkmark with scale transitions. Disables itself for 1.5 seconds after click to provide feedback, and includes a tooltip.
use_when: Letting users copy text or code with visual confirmation feedback.
avoid_when: When you need actual clipboard functionality (button is demo-only).
a11y: Uses aria-label that updates based on copied state and aria-hidden for icons. Tooltip provides additional context.
